sources.caveats: Generation queues; large-load queues from ERCOT/PJM to be added

sources.name: OECD Product Market Regulation indicators
sources.caveats: Economy-wide, not AI-specific; context for entry_conditions

sources.name: Hugging Face Hub API (model licences, open-weights flag, downloads)
sources.caveats: Downloads are not use; open_interfaces proxy

sources.name: Stanford HAI AI Index 2026
sources.caveats: Compiles other sources (including non-probability surveys such as organisation-adoption figures); use to locate primaries, not as a source of cells

sources.name: OpenAI GDPval (task basket, rubrics and expert-graded quality; gold subset of 220 tasks)
sources.access: Hugging Face download (220 gold tasks, 2.29 GB); paper arXiv 2510.04374
sources.licence: not stated on dataset page; confirm before redistribution
sources.caveats: Vendor-authored; one-shot knowledge-work tasks only; public tasks can be contaminated (canary string); automated grader experimental; headline 100x cost claim excludes oversight and integration, never log as a cell; use as task basket and quality anchor, not as a price series

sources.name: Ramp AI Index (card/invoice transactions; mirrored on FRED as RAMPAI* series)
sources.access: web page; FRED monthly series e.g. RAMPAIOPENAI
sources.licence: page states none; FRED asks for citation, copyright Ramp Business Corporation; confirm
sources.caveats: Paid AI use only (understates free/personal use); platform-skewed sample; level not comparable to Eurostat/BTOS; use for momentum and as candidate bridge across the BTOS Nov 2025 break; provider shares logged for concentration only

sources.name: AI Hallucination Cases database (Damien Charlotin)
sources.caveats: Counts cases courts noticed and addressed; mostly self-represented litigants; inclusion is a judgement call; normalise by case volumes before using as penetration

sources.name: OpenRouter rankings and Data API
sources.caveats: Routed traffic only, not users or spend; developer-skewed; market share counts requests; verbosity and tokenisation differ across models

sources.name: Cloudflare Radar AI Insights
sources.caveats: Verified only from a Feb 2025 blog post; DNS popularity is not usage; robots.txt covers top 10,000 domains and declared directives only; check current datasets

sources.name: GitHub Innovation Graph and Octoverse
sources.access: Innovation Graph downloads (confirm); Octoverse is a report
sources.caveats: Octoverse checked (4.3M+ AI repos; ~1.1M repos import an LLM SDK, +178% y/y) but is a report, not a dataset; public activity only; country from self-reported location; Innovation Graph not opened

sources.name: ERCOT / TCEQ data-centre interconnection and air-permit queue
sources.caveats: Verified in brief 2026-10-25 (Governor Abbott 21 Sept directive, TCEQ 19 Oct reply, 8.7 GW across 6 campuses, 400+ data centres in ERCOT audit due 10 Dec 2026)

sources.name: Taiwan MOEA monthly export orders
sources.caveats: Seen via Focus Taiwan only; industry-based (electronics, ICT), not AI-specific: proxy flag

sources.name: China NBS monthly industrial robot output
sources.caveats: Aug 2026 +34.6% y/y seen via CGTN only; industrial robots, not AI-specific: proxy flag; some months reported from an industry federation rather than NBS

sources.name: Survey of Working Arrangements and Attitudes (SWAA)
sources.access: time series Excel/JSON; microdata on request
sources.caveats: Data page does not list AI items; Bick et al. report a Dec 2024 SWAA wave with generative-AI use; confirm AI series ids; online panel

sources.name: Real-Time Population Survey / The Rapid Adoption of Generative AI (NBER w32966)
sources.caveats: Aug and Nov 2024 waves only; not peer-reviewed; online panel; self-reported; use as diffusion-speed benchmark against PCs and internet

sources.name: Firm Data on AI (NBER w34836; Atlanta Fed, Bank of England, Bundesbank, Macquarie)
sources.access: working paper; microdata availability not stated
sources.caveats: Single fielding Nov 2025-Jan 2026; executive-reported; useful convergent check against Eurostat and BTOS

sources.name: Stack Overflow Developer Survey 2026
sources.access: dataset promised on GitHub 'in a few weeks'
sources.caveats: Developer self-selected sample; software sector only

sources.name: Stockholm Resilience Centre: Planetary boundaries (nine boundaries, status, Planetary Health Check link)
sources.access: web page; papers; annual Planetary Health Check
sources.licence: graphics CC BY-NC-ND 3.0 (no alteration, non-commercial); cite values, redraw panel
sources.caveats: Page says seven of nine transgressed but names neither the seven nor control variables; own figures inconsistent (six for 2023); build the panel from primary papers and the Planetary Health Check, print assessment year; reference frame, not an AI series

sources.name: Richardson et al. 2023, Earth beyond six of nine planetary boundaries (control variables and values)
sources.access: open access paper (not opened; fetch failed)
sources.caveats: Values seen only via a French government statistics page presenting the 2023 revision; open the paper before logging; later updates supersede (2025 and 2026 Planetary Health Check)

sources.name: Planetary Health Check (PIK / Planetary Boundaries Science Lab), annual
sources.caveats: Linked from the SRC page and cited as the source of the 2025 count; find the 2025 and 2026 editions and record per-boundary status before use
